 Michael C. Hall's titular serial killer is still racking up that kill count and dealing with his personal demons as he returns for Dexter: Resurrection season 2 .
 You can watch Dexter: Resurrection season 2 online from anywhere with a VPN .
 Dexter may have narrowly avoided getting caught at the end of season 1, but by the looks of things in the trailer for season 2, his murderous urges are still as strong as ever. That's disturbingly impressive, especially considering the latest episodes will feature a three-year time jump.
 Advertisement Advertisement This time around, Dexter continues to hunt for the New York Ripper (Brian Cox), all while being part of a secret serial killer society himself. One thing's for sure, Dexter is never anything less than messy and chaotic.
 We also know that Uma Thurman is back as Charley for season 2 of Dexter: Resurrection , which is sure to spice things up. Meanwhile, Dexter will be dealing with a midlife crisis, and trying to maintain his unorthodox relationship with Harrison.
 Ready to see Dexter Morgan at his bloody, brutal best? Here's how to watch Dexter: Resurrection season 2 online – from anywhere.
 Can I watch Dexter: Resurrection season 2 for free?
 You can't watch Dexter: Resurrection season 2 for free, at least not in its entirety. In the UK, you can get a free 7-day trial of Paramount+ , though, so you could at least watch a couple of episodes if you time it right.
 Advertisement Advertisement In the US you could take advantage of the Walmart+ deal which gives you a Paramount+ subscription (or Peacock) for just $1. Access to the streaming service is essential if you want to watch Dexter: Resurrection season 2, as it's an exclusive Paramount series.

 The US premiere of Dexter: Resurrection season 2 is on Friday, October 30, with episodes playing on Paramount+ for subscribers.

 Paramount+ plans start at $8.99 per month, but you could get a subscription for just $1 per month with Walmart+ .
